Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X71/X71n1414.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liao’an Qingyu. Liao'an Qingyu owns the retained deployment, crowning the founder in verse — walking and understanding in accord, lineage-telling both penetrating, eyes emptying the four seas — one flower, five leaves, each taking its share of spring wind.

Senses.Explanation: The walking-and-understanding accord of the Chan records: the founder's test — set in the mirror-treatise, unpacked as the understanding-place being the walking-place, turned back with where-is-the-word-head, demanded of lineage heirs, and crowned in verse at the founder's own memorial. Yongming Yanshou sets the founder's stamp into the charter chapter of the Source-Mirror — bright in the buddha-mind lineament, without a hair of error, walking and understanding in accord, thereby named the ancestor — as the witness his whole transmission argument leans on, Tianran Hanshi quotes the ancients' same verdict and unpacks it in his own ruling: his understanding-place is his walking-place and his walking-place his understanding-place — not understanding so today and only walking so another day, but the ancients walked so first and only now do we understand so — against the recitation-bench monks who learn a smooth mouth and cry I know the buddha, I know the Chan way, Dufeng Shan grieves that the tricksters who merely want the thing in hand have never met the ancestor's admonition, and blames the teachers who never weigh the student's vessel yet scheme to gather disciples for private credit, dragging the school into shame, and Shenfeng Xian, asked — with one thing left Vairocana falls among ordinary men, with the myriad things gone Samantabhadra loses his sphere — how does one get to walking-and-understanding accord, turns the ask back: where is the word-head? Zhe'an Jingfan opens his ten essentials for disciples with it: the ancient learners strove hundred-citied and ten-thousand-li, hunger and cold unheeded, praise and blame unmoving, until the great matter pierced through — a walking-and-understanding-accorded one must carry the line, so fame and gain cannot fence him, while today's learners scramble for bequeathed titles and nine in ten go blank when their difference-conditions are probed, Hansong Zhicao fires the verse over monk Sanyu's pyre — one bamboo hat at ease across the whole world, walking and understanding in accord with the wondrous Lotus Flower, and after the frost-age smoke hardens, wherever he meets people the three carts are there to point to, Xueqiao Yuanxin writes the minister Li Mengbai that in this late age one truly-investigating, truly-awake person is one in ten thousand — the great master said, walking and understanding in accord, thereby named the ancestor, yet people today care nothing for it: opinion-guessing with the life-death knot intact, ten-tenths fur-and-feather resemblance, then acting wildly before others until the school gate's floor is swept, and Liao'an Qingyu at the founder's memorial holds up the incense and crowns him in verse — walking and understanding in accord, lineage-telling both penetrating, eyes emptying the four seas, breath spitting the long rainbow — not yet left the Western Heaven, deserving a good beating; once come to the Eastern Land, tolerated for now — one flower, five leaves, each taking its share of spring wind.
